description.zh:
文档库名称。

> 由[CreateDocumentCollection](~~2618448~~)接口创建。您可以调用[ListDocumentCollections](~~2618452~~)接口查看已经创建的文档库。
description.en:
The name of the document collection.

> A document collection is created by calling the [CreateDocumentCollection](~~2618448~~) operation. You can call the [ListDocumentCollections](~~2618452~~) operation to view existing document collections.

description.zh:
开启了向量引擎优化的实例ID。

> 您可以调用[DescribeDBInstances](~~86911~~)接口查看目标地域下所有的AnalyticDB PostgreSQL实例的详情，包括实例ID。
description.en:
The ID of the instance that has the vector engine optimization feature enabled.

> You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](~~86911~~) operation to query the details of all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances in a region, including instance IDs.

description.zh: 上传文档的任务ID，由`UploadDocumentAsync`接口获得。
description.en: The ID of the document upload task, which is obtained from the UploadDocumentAsync operation.

description.zh:
命名空间，用于租户隔离，默认为public。

> 可以通过[CreateNamespace](~~2401495~~)创建，通过[ListNamespaces](~~2401502~~)接口查看列表。
description.en:
The namespace, which is used for tenant isolation. Default value: public.

> You can create a namespace by calling [CreateNamespace](~~2401495~~) and view the list of namespaces by calling [ListNamespaces](~~2401502~~).

description.zh:
命名空间对应的密码。

> 本值为CreateNamespace接口指定。
description.en:
The password of the namespace.

> This value is specified by the CreateNamespace operation.
The region ID of the instance.

descriptions.zh:
此接口为UploadDocumentAsync的相关接口。可通过UploadDocumentAsync创建一个上传任务，并得到一个JobId，然后通过此接口查看Job的执行信息。

> 使用建议
> - 按照文档复杂度和切分后的向量条数评估超时，一般不超过2小时。
descriptions.en:
This operation is related to UploadDocumentAsync. You can call UploadDocumentAsync to create an upload task and obtain a job ID, and then call this operation to view the execution information of the job.

> Usage notes
> - Estimate the timeout based on the document complexity and the number of vector entries after chunking. The timeout generally does not exceed 2 hours.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun gpdb get-upload-document-job --db-instance-id gp-xxxxxxxxx --namespace mynamespace --collection document --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --namespace-password testpassword --job-id bf8f7bc4-9276-44f7-9c22-1d06edc8dfd1 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun gpdb GetUploadDocumentJob --region cn-hangzhou --DBInstanceId 'gp-xxxxxxxxx' --Collection document --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --NamespacePassword testpassword --Namespace mynamespace --JobId 'bf8f7bc4-9276-44f7-9c22-1d06edc8dfd1'
